scope: The extant Nakhal Fort masonry ensemble built around its rocky prominence, with the mapped stepped outer walls, round bastions, fortified upper court and entrance stair.

references.caption: Nakhal fort - Batina region - Sultanate of Oman
references.alt: Nakhal fort - Batina region - Sultanate of Oman
references.artist: No machine-readable author provided. Nabieh~commonswiki assumed (based on copyright claims).

originalReview.notes: The original image shows a pale tan ensemble directly on rough rock with a dominant round tower, closely stepped rectangular upper masses, crenellations, small square and arched openings, and lower perimeter walls.

quallaSearch.notes: The exact already-published Qualla photograph matches the sole native Commons file. The original upload and original same-second PD-self dedication are by the same account. Later attribution boilerplate describes the absence of a structured author field. The original timestamp and dedication bind the file to the releasing account.
